mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM posts p WHERE p.status = 'normal'
AND p.created_at >= #{since}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_tags pt WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND pt.tag_id = #{tagId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_files pf WHERE pf.post_id = p.id AND pf.source = #{source} )
ORDER BY
p.like_count p.comment_count p.favorite_count p.view_count (p.like_count * 3 + p.favorite_count * 5 + p.comment_count * 4 + p.view_count * 1) p.created_at
ASC DESC
, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
